title: Autism Spectrum Disorder: Symptoms, Causes and Getting Assessed in India
seoTitle: Autism Spectrum Disorder: Symptoms, Causes, India Guide
seoDescription: Autism signs include late speech, little response to name and repetitive play. See the causes, the vaccine facts and how to get assessed in India.
excerpt: Early signs from babyhood to the teens, what Indian research says about how common autism is, what raises the likelihood, and how RBSK, district early intervention centres and the UDID card can help.
